text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The group passed through the highway to the temple in search of New Year's ingredients. Along the way, Pecorine stops in her tracks.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おせちの材料を求め、街道を通り神殿へ向かう一行。
その道中でペコリーヌは足を止めるのだった。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: What's wrong? If we just follow this road, we'll reach the temple, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしたのじゃ？
このまま道なりに行けば神殿なんじゃろ？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Could we take a little detour?
text_block_list.orig_text: ちょっと遠回りしちゃってもいいですか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I don't mind personally, but what's up ahead?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは構わないけどさ。
この先に何があるんだい？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Now that you mention it, I've heard of it before. It was a guild race held in the New Year.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば
聞いたことがあるのう。
新年にやるギルド対抗レースじゃったか。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Huh! Is this the road where you all competed against the Mountain God in the Lucky Guild Race? I read about your exploits in the newspaper.
text_block_list.orig_text:
へぇ！
ここが福ギルドレースで山神様と競り合ったっていうあの道かい！
活躍は新聞で読んだよ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: A guild race?
text_block_list.orig_text: ギルドレース……？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes. The guild race we're talking about is...
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
ギルドレースというのはですね……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: So that's what happened... I never would've imagined that you also had won it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなこともあったのね……
しかも
優勝してただなんて
知らなかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: And so, during that race this was the last section before the goal. Thinking about it now, Suzume's running back then was truly amazing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
で、
その時の最後のストレート区間がここだったのよ。
今考えてもすごかったわよね、
スズメの走り。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: A dead heat race against that giant mountain god... It was a fierce battle indeed.
text_block_list.orig_text:
巨大な山神さまとのデッドヒート……
まさに激闘でございました。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's right... Everyone here's gone through a lot of things I don't know anything about...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうよね……
みんな
私の知らないいろんな経験をしてきたんだもの……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Such a fierce battle... how did she manage to win?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな激闘、
どうやって勝ったの？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: If I had to offer one comment on how... never give up, would be the one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しいて言うなら……
絶対に諦めないこと、
ですかね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Never give up...
text_block_list.orig_text: 諦めないこと……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Well, speaking of ourselves, we have a lot of people in our guildhouse who don't know when to quit. And Suzume from back then fit right in with us.
text_block_list.orig_text:
まあ、
うちは諦めの悪いのが揃ってるからね。
あの時のスズメも含めて。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Maaaaan, thinking back to that time, my hands are still sweating...
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや～
あの時のことを思い出すと
今でも手に汗握っちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: ...while my stomach's still rumbling!
text_block_list.orig_text: お腹も鳴っちゃいますね！

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: WHY?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なんでよ！！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: I was just reminded of the feast that we had following the race☆
text_block_list.orig_text: レース後の祝賀会でのごちそうを思い出しちゃいました☆

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Yes. It was very delicious.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はい。
大変美味しゅうございましたね。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: In the end, that too ended up being a high-class monster dish! Well, it was delicious, but... If Sheffy had been there with us at the time, wouldn't we have been able to win more easily?
text_block_list.orig_text:
結局あれも高級魔物料理だったじゃないの！
まあ美味しかったけどさ……
もしあの時シェフィがいてくれたら
もっと楽に優勝できてたんじゃない？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: All those memories you have that I don't know about... I'm a little jealous.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の知らない、
みんなの思い出……
ちょっとうらやましいな。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Jealous, you say...? Don't tell me... you really wanted to eat that high-class monster dish?
text_block_list.orig_text:
うらやましいって……
まさか高級魔物料理が？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Umu... What seems to be the matter, Sheffy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
どうしたのじゃ、
シェフィ？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Ah. I'm sorry. I was just thinking out loud.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？
……ごめんなさい。
ちょっと考え事してて。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Whoops... I can see it. The temple's over there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっと……
見えてきたよ。
神殿だ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: All right! I'll be the first one to get there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
よし！　
わらわが一番乗りじゃー！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Please wait, Lady Illya. It is very dangerous to be running about in your traditional clothes.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お待ちくださいイリヤさま。
晴れ着で走ると危険でございます。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Wait for meeeeee.....!
text_block_list.orig_text: 待ってくださいよー！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Upon arriving at the temple, the group prayed within the grounds.
text_block_list.orig_text: 神殿に到着した一同は境内でお参りをしていた。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: May we all enjoy a delicious meal at the same table...
text_block_list.orig_text: 美味しいご飯が食べられますように。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: May everyone be safe and peaceful...
text_block_list.orig_text:
みなさまの平穏と
無事を……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: May I won't be subject to eating any strange dish this entire year...
text_block_list.orig_text: 今年こそ変なものを食べさせられませんように……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Everyone... they're paying their respects so seriously...
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんな
真面目にお参りしてるわね……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: By the by, there are a lot of people here now. Let's try to not get separated... Hey, huh? Everyone, where are you? Korosuke? Pecorine?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても人が多くなってきたわね。
はぐれないように……
ちょっ、
あれ？　
みんなどこよ？　
コロ助？　
ペコリーヌ？

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Uwah, I'm getting swept away!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わわっ、
流されちゃいます！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Lady Sheffy, it seems we'll be heading to the stall ahead of you, so please take your time.
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィさま、
わたくしたちは先に出店の方へ向かっておりますので
ごゆっくりどうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Yes, I understand.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええ、
わかったわ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Mmmmmmmm...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むむむむ
む～……！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ruka-san seems very quiet while... Illya-san... seems kind of demonic.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ルカさんは静かに……
イリヤさんは……
なんだか鬼気迫るような。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: No matter what, my power will...! Hm? What's wrong, Sheffy? Aren't you going to pray?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとしても
我が力を～……！
む？　
どうしたシェフィよ。
お主は祈らんのか？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Um... I always pray that my memories will come back every day. I don't really know what else to pray for.
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
記憶が戻ってほしいっていうのは、
いつも祈ってるし。
他に何を祈っていいのか、
よく分からなくて。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Anything will do. Good health, good luck... I hope that anything you wish for will arrive.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでもいいのさ。
健康でも幸運でも、
欲しいものが手に入りますように、
でもね。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Is it really okay to wish for anything?
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなものでもいいんですか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Of course. Praying is also a way to confirm your own feelings on something.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん。
お祈りっていうのは自分の気持ちを確認する場でもあるんだからさ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: If you're worried about something, we're here to listen, you know? There surely are some matters that cannot be disclosed even within one's guild.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悩みがあるなら聞いてやるぞ？
同じギルドならばこそ
話せぬ悩みというものもあるじゃろう。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: They say that even a chance meeting can lead to a deep bond. So why don't you take this opportunity to let some things out from that furisode?
text_block_list.orig_text:
袖振り合うも他生の縁、
ってね。
振袖だけにこの機会に話してみないかい？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: In that case... just a little...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら……
少しだけ……

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Everyone at the Gourmet Guild has memories with each other from before I joined, a bond that I'm no part of...
text_block_list.orig_text:
【美食殿】のみんなには、
私が入る前の思い出があって
入る前の絆もあって……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hmm, so you're saying you can sense a distance between you and them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ、
距離を感じてしまう、
と。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Of course, everyone is nice to me. But that's exactly why... I sometimes wonder if it's okay for me, someone who doesn't even know her own past, to be with everyone...
text_block_list.orig_text:
もちろん、
みんなはよくしてくれるんです。
でも、
だからこそ……
自分自身の過去も分からない私が
みんなと
一緒にいていいのかって
思うときもあって……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Sheffy. Have you heard about my story? Of how I've woken up from a long slumber?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむ……
シェフィよ。
わらわが永い眠りから目覚めたという話は知っておるか？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes... The other people from Diabolos woke you up, Illya-san. That's what I've heard.
text_block_list.orig_text:
え、
ええ……
【悪魔偽王国軍（ディアボロス）】の人たちがイリヤさんを
起こしたって聞いてるわ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: The moment I woke up, I looked around me only to see nobody I knew. Not only that, but I had lost most of my former power.
text_block_list.orig_text:
目が覚めた時は
知った者など一人もおらぬでなあ。
しかも
かつての力を
ほとんど失っておった。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: From the perspective of this era, I am merely a relic from the past. I thought of myself as a lost child who had been left alone and abandoned, but...
text_block_list.orig_text:
この時代からすれば
わらわは過去の存在。
一人取り残された迷子のようなものじゃと思っておったが……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, I was surrounded not only by the members of the Demon Army of Diabolos, but also by many others, including you all. As I am right now, I cannot imagine a life without you all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
気が付けば
【悪魔偽王国軍（ディアボロス）】の者たちだけではなく
お主たちも含めた
多くの者たちに囲まれておる。
今となっては、
皆のおらぬ生活の方が考えられぬくらいじゃ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: As for me, when I first came to Landosol, I was merely a lonely traveler. But before I knew it, I had made many new connections.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシも
ランドソルに来たときは
身軽な一人旅だったはずなんだけどね。
気が付けばいろいろと繋がりが増えたもんさ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: The bonds between people form without us even realizing it. I thought I was arrogant enough to understand it in words, but when I experienced actually connecting with someone I realized my own foolishness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
人の縁っていうのは、
自分でも気づかないうちに繋がっていく。
言葉じゃ分かっていたつもりだったけど、
実際に繋がってみないと実感はわかないもんさね。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That's right. Some things can only be understood once you've actually connected. I was also worried of opening up to my new peers at first too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃのう。
実際に繋がってみて
初めて分かることもある。
わらわも最初は不安がなかったわけではない。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: No one knows about my past except for me. But still, everyone follows me. I'm speaking for me here, but isn't it the same for you, Sheffy?
text_block_list.orig_text:
わらわの過去のことは
わらわ以外は皆知らぬ。
だが、
それでも皆はわらわについてきておるのじゃ。
それはシェフィも同じであろう？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Are you telling me... to not worry about the past?
text_block_list.orig_text:
過去のことは、
気にするな……
ってことですか？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: That's not it. Everyone has their own way of dealing with the past. But it's a waste to use it as a reason to deny the present.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうわけじゃないよ。
過去との向き合い方は人それぞれだからね。
ただ、
今を否定する材料にしてしまうのは
もったいないってことさ。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: A waste... so, I guess it's better to cherish the present than the past that's been lost?
text_block_list.orig_text:
もったいない……
無くした過去よりも、
今を大切にする……
ってことかしら？

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! That's quite the thing to say! Certainly so. It's such a shame to waste everyone's good will around you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はっはっは！　
なかなか良いことを言うではないか！
そうじゃのう、
せっかくの皆の好意がもったいないわ。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: All you have to do now is respond honestly to the feelings that are directed at you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今は、
向けられた気持ちに素直に応えればよいだけじゃろう。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: The feelings directed at me... That's right. Somehow, I feel better now. Thank you very much, you two.
text_block_list.orig_text:
みんなの気持ちに……
そう、
ですね。
なんだか気持ちが楽になりました。
二人とも、
ありがとうございます。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: Don't mention it, I don't mind. It's a ruler sworn duty to guide those who are lost!
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあに、
構わぬ。
迷えるものを導くのも支配者の役目じゃ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Experience is worth more than a turtle's shell. I'm glad I was able to help you. More importantly... Have you decided what you want to pray for?
text_block_list.orig_text:
亀の甲より年の功、
ってやつさ。
役に立てたならよかったよ。
それよりも……
お祈りしたいことは、
決まったんじゃないかい？

text_block_list.name: シェフィ
text_block_list.text:
来年も、
その先も……
みんなと一緒にいられますように……！
text_block_list.orig_text:
来年も、
その先も……
みんなと一緒にいられますように……！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Sheffy-CHAAAAAAAN? Thank goodness, you were pretty close by. We were worried since we were waiting but you weren't coming by, so here I am to fetch you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
シェフィちゃ～ん？　
よかった、
結構近くにいたんですね。
待っててもなかなか来ないから
心配になって捜しにきちゃいました！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry. My prayer seems to have taken its time...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんなさい。
お祈りが長引いちゃって……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: What were you praying for?
text_block_list.orig_text: 何をお祈りしてたんですか？

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: That's... a secret!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それは……
内緒！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh? No way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えー、
そんな～！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Being dejected like that won't make her fess it up. Come on, let’s get going.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんな野暮なこと聞くもんじゃないよ？
ほら、
早く行こうじゃないか。

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That's right! We need to be fast and get our hands on those lucky mochi! As many as we can muster for my complete revival! I'll just buy them all up if I have to!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃ！　
縁起物の餅を早く手に入れねば！
わらわの完全なる復活のためには
いくらあってもよい！
いっそ買い占めてやるのじゃ！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Kyaru-chan and Kokkoro-chan went ahead to buy them, so let's go ahead and meet up with them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
キャルちゃんとコッコロちゃんが一足先に買いに行ってますから、
早く合流しましょう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: However, when Kokkoro and Kyaru arrived at a stall selling lucky mochi, an unexpected event awaited them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかし縁起物のお餅を売っている出店にやってきたコッコロとキャルを
待っていたのは、
思わぬ事態だった。

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: They're all... sold out?
text_block_list.orig_text:
売り切れ、
でございますか？

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What do you mean?! There were a lot of them when we passed by earlier!
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ！？　
どういうことよ！
さっきあたしたちが通りがかった時はたくさんあったじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Mochi Vendor
text_block_list.text: That's... someone passed by and just bought all of them...
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが、
先ほど全部買われた方がおられまして……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: What THE HELL DOES THAT MEAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAN?!
text_block_list.orig_text: なによそれーーー！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: No way~...
text_block_list.orig_text: そんなぁ～……

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: It seems that all the lucky mochi at the temple's stalls have been bought up...
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうやら、
神殿の出店全てから、
縁起物のお餅が買い占められて
しまっているようでございます……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: C-U-R-S-E THEM! Who would do something so inhuman?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おのれ～！　
どこのどいつがそのような非道なことを～！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, I just heard you planning the same thing just a second ago...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こらこら、
さっきアンタも同じこと企んでただろうに。

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...
text_block_list.orig_text: あはは……

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Ugh, I really wanted to eat the mochi made at the temple...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うう、
神殿のお餅、
食べたかったです……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: There's nothing we can do about what we don't have. Let's go to our next destination.
text_block_list.orig_text:
無いものはしょうがないじゃない。
次の目的地に行くわよ。

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes
text_block_list.orig_text: は～い……

text_block_list.name: Illya
text_block_list.text: That's right... Where are we going next?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうじゃの……
次はどこに行くんじゃ？

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: We were thinking of heading to Oma next.
text_block_list.orig_text: オーマに向かおうかと。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Sounds good. Let's get going! Come on, come on! Hurry!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいねえ。
さっそく行こうじゃないか！
ほらほら！　
早く！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Yes, let's pull ourselves together! Delicious seafood awaits us!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうですね、
気を取り直していきましょう！
美味しい海産物が待ってますよ！

text_block_list.name: Kokkoro
text_block_list.text: Hehehe. Lady Ruka and Lady Pecorine seems to be in full spirits for where we're headed next.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
ルカさまもペコリーヌさまも楽しそうでございますね。

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Heheheh... That was a piece of cake. Well, it costed some money, but if it's this much, it will come back fairly quick...
text_block_list.orig_text:
へっへっへ……
ちょろいもんだぜ。
まあ種銭はかかっちまったが
これくらいならすぐに……

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: Eek! Hey! Look ahead when you're walking!
text_block_list.orig_text:
きゃっ！　
ちょっと！　
ちゃんと前見て歩きなさいよ！

text_block_list.name: Suspicious Man
text_block_list.text: Shut up! Don’t get in my way!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせえ！　
邪魔すんじゃねえよ！

text_block_list.name: Sheffy
text_block_list.text: Are you all right, Kyaru?
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫？　
キャル。

text_block_list.name: Karyl
text_block_list.text: I'm fine, but... What's with that smirk on his face? Ahh, it pisses me off!
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だけど……
なんなのよアイツ。
ニヤニヤして。
あー、
ムカつくわね！

text_block_list.name: Pecorine
text_block_list.text: Then! Let's head out for Oma!
text_block_list.orig_text:
では、
オーマに向けて出発ですよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
text_block_list.orig_text: おう！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Thus, despite some problems, the journey to build the osechi and create new memories continues.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして、多少の問題はありながらも
思い出おせち巡りの旅は続くのであった。
